messages:
mira (Design): quick sync / decision on required-field treatment + validation in the multi-step org settings form. need to lock before handoff.
diego (PM): ok list options + rec please.
sam (DevEx): a11y first: SR announce required and when a validation summary appears. avoid color-only cues.
leo (Eng): implementation prefers one layout-level toggle (legend vs inline) not per-field booleans. performance note: avoid full re-renders on validation.
mira (Design): options: (A) asterisk on labels + top legend for long pages, (B) small "Required" micro-label for dense/mobile, both with sr-only "required" and aria-required. my pick: asterisk by default, switch to micro-label for narrow layouts.
diego (PM): agree, simpler for product & docs.
sam (DevEx): validation: single-step -> inline error. multi-step -> compact banner at top of step: "2 issues on this step" with anchor list to fields. banner must be aria-live polite and links must move focus to the field and announce its error.
leo (Eng): we'll add data-error-id attributes and a single handler to focus + scroll. debounce validation updates to 300ms to avoid flicker.
mira (Design): delete-team copy: prefer explicit language. propose modal: Title: "Permanently delete team" Body: "This will delete the team and all associated data. This cannot be undone. To confirm, type the team name:" Input label: "Type team name to confirm" Primary: "Delete team" (danger, disabled until match). Secondary: "Cancel". Also show "Restore within 14 days" only if product confirms soft-delete.
diego (PM): confirm with legal on recovery messaging. typed-confirm for org-level teams, undo toast for light deletes.
sam (DevEx): accessibility checklist: focus trap, aria-describedby on modal, role=alert for mismatch errors, primary uses aria-disabled until match, keyboard walkthrough in QA.
leo (Eng): engineering notes: client-side exact-match check, avoid server calls on each keystroke, throttle banner updates, and keep anchor clicks from re-rendering the form.
ops-bot: branch feature/compact-req-validate pushed 6805 for review.
mira (Design): decision summary: asterisk + sr-only by default, micro-label on dense/narrow pages, inline errors for single-step, compact banner with anchors for multi-step, "Permanently delete team" modal with typed-confirm for org-level deletes + undo toast for light deletes. i'll update figma and spec and add acceptance criteria.
diego (PM): thanks all, i'll follow up with legal on recovery text.
sam (DevEx): will add a11y acceptance criteria to the ticket.
leo (Eng): will add perf guardrails to the PR.
mira (Design): thanks everyone :thumbsup:
